## Overview

You have **one daily sea surface temperature field** on a regular lat–lon grid. You want **|∇SST|** — how sharply SST changes **across space** on that day — in **°C km⁻¹**.

This tutorial builds a **toy ocean** on an **80 × 80** grid:

- **~19 °C** on the **north, south, east, and west** margins (open-ocean background).  
- A **small, meandering thermal front** through the **middle** (~0.35 °C step, smooth in space).  
- The same **centred finite-difference** recipe used on reanalysis SST, then side-by-side maps.

**You need:** R and [`terra`](https://rspatial.org/terra/).

**This is not:** SST changing over time at one point, or a front-probability layer.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Load terra

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 120)
```

```{r packages}
pacman::p_load(terra)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 2. Toy SST: 19 °C margins + front in the centre

We fill the raster **cell by cell** with `xyFromCell()` so longitude and latitude are not swapped (a common source of “striped” fake oceans).

```{r toy-raster}
n <- 80L

sst <- terra::rast(
  ncols = n,
  nrows = n,
  xmin = 170,
  xmax = 170.5,
  ymin = -45,
  ymax = -44.5,
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
)

ex <- ext(sst)
xy <- terra::xyFromCell(sst, 1:ncell(sst))
lon <- xy[, 1]
lat <- xy[, 2]
lon_n <- (lon - ex[1]) / (ex[2] - ex[1])
lat_n <- (lat - ex[3]) / (ex[4] - ex[3])

# Fade the front to zero toward each edge → margins stay ~19 °C (no hard clip).
edge_taper <- pmin(
  pmin(lon_n / 0.15, (1 - lon_n) / 0.15),
  pmin(lat_n / 0.15, (1 - lat_n) / 0.15),
  1
)

# Front longitude wiggles with latitude (meandering boundary).
front_lon <- 170.25 + 0.012 * sin((lat_n - 0.5) * 2 * pi * 3)

# tanh(): smooth transition over ~0.008° (~1 km) — not a one-cell jump.
sst_vals <- 19 + 0.35 * tanh(-(lon - front_lon) / 0.008) * edge_taper
terra::values(sst) <- sst_vals

c(
  res_lon_deg = terra::res(sst)[1],
  res_lat_deg = terra::res(sst)[2],
  sst_min = min(sst_vals),
  sst_max = max(sst_vals)
)
```

```{r plot-sst}
plot(sst, main = "Toy SST (°C) — ~19 °C margins, front through centre")
```

Expect **teal ~19 °C** around the rim, **warmer west / cooler east** of the wavy centre line, and **continuous** colour through the front (not two solid blocks).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 3. Cell width in kilometres

```{r cell-km}
res <- terra::res(sst)
clat <- mean(
  terra::yFromCell(sst, seq_len(min(5000L, terra::ncell(sst)))),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
dx_km <- as.numeric(res[1]) * 111.32 * cos(clat * pi / 180)
dy_km <- as.numeric(res[2]) * 111.32
c(dx_km = dx_km, dy_km = dy_km, mean_lat = clat)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Centred differences → |∇SST|

```{r sst-grad-fn}
sst_grad_magnitude_layer <- function(sst) {
  if (is.null(sst) || !terra::ncell(sst)) return(NULL)
  res <- terra::res(sst)
  clat <- mean(
    terra::yFromCell(sst, seq_len(min(5000L, terra::ncell(sst)))),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  dx_km <- as.numeric(res[1]) * 111.32 * cos(clat * pi / 180)
  dy_km <- as.numeric(res[2]) * 111.32
  if (!is.finite(dx_km) || dx_km <= 0 || !is.finite(dy_km) || dy_km <= 0) return(NULL)
  w_x <- matrix(c(0, 0, 0, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 0, 0, 0), nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  w_y <- matrix(c(0, -0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.5, 0), nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  gx <- terra::focal(sst, w = w_x, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE, pad = TRUE) / dx_km
  gy <- terra::focal(sst, w = w_y, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE, pad = TRUE) / dy_km
  sqrt(gx^2 + gy^2)
}

grad <- sst_grad_magnitude_layer(sst)

# Mask outer rim for plotting only (focal pad can inflate |∇SST| on the frame).
grad_show <- grad
edge <- lon_n < 0.08 | lon_n > 0.92 | lat_n < 0.08 | lat_n > 0.92
gvals <- terra::values(grad_show)
gvals[edge] <- NA
terra::values(grad_show) <- gvals

summary(grad, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r plot-both}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(sst, main = "SST (°C)")
plot(grad_show, main = expression("|"*nabla*SST|" (°C km"^-1*")"))
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

**|∇SST|** should **light up along the wavy front** and stay **low** on the ~19 °C flanks.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 5. Quick checks

```{r sanity}
flat <- sst * 0 + 19
g_flat <- sst_grad_magnitude_layer(flat)
interior <- !(lon_n < 0.08 | lon_n > 0.92 | lat_n < 0.08 | lat_n > 0.92)
max_front <- max(terra::values(grad)[interior], na.rm = TRUE)
mean_flat <- terra::global(g_flat, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
stopifnot(is.finite(mean_flat), max_front > 0.05, max_front < 3)
c(flat_mean = mean_flat, front_max_interior = max_front)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 6. Common mix-ups

| Idea | Reality |
|------|---------|
| Gradient = day-to-day SST at a point | **Spatial** differences on **one** daily layer |
| Blocky north–south stripes in a toy map | Often **matrix orientation** — use `xyFromCell()` |
| Kelvin vs Celsius | Differences match; report SST in one convention |
| Edge spikes in \|∇SST\| | **Pad** + frame taper — mask rim for display |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 7. Real data

1. One daily SST layer on a grid you trust.  
2. Same function per day if needed.  
3. `terra::extract` at track lon/lat (check lon convention).  
4. Aggregate to your model time step.

[Copernicus Marine](https://data.marine.copernicus.eu/) for GLORYS-style products.
